# Posters Science Extraction API — v1.0.1

## Overview

A REST service that extracts structured, machine-readable metadata from scientific conference posters. Posters are submitted as PDF or image files and the service returns JSON conforming to the posters.science poster schema. Processing is job-based — submit a poster, then poll for the structured result — and runs entirely on local infrastructure, so poster files are not sent to third-party services.

## Pipeline

- PDF text: pdfplumber with XY-cut reading-order reconstruction, falling back to PyMuPDF for low-text or image-only PDFs.
- Image OCR: Qwen2-VL-7B vision-language model.
- JSON structuring: a verbatim mirror of Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct using greedy decoding (the model is not fine-tuned).

## Validation

19 of 20 posters (95%) in the annotated corpus pass all thresholds. Aggregate scores are word capture 0.92, ROUGE-L 0.85, number capture 0.97, and field proportion 0.88. A poster passes when word capture, ROUGE-L, and number capture are each at least 0.75 and field proportion is between 0.50 and 1.50. Full per-poster results and methodology live in the poster2json evaluation docs: https://github.com/fairdataihub/poster2json/blob/main/docs/evaluation.md

## Requirements

- GPU: CUDA-capable with at least 16GB VRAM (24GB or more recommended to hold both models at once)
- RAM: 32GB or more
- Storage: roughly 50GB for model weights
- Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.0+, CUDA 11.8+

## Running

Run locally with `python api.py` (defaults to host 0.0.0.0, port 8000), or in production with `docker compose -f docker-compose-prod.yml up -d`.

Endpoints:
- `GET /health` — service health check
- `POST /jobs/check` — submit a poster for extraction and poll for the structured JSON result
